Definition: from G4154; respiration, a breeze:--breath, wind.
BiblicalUsage: Pnoe is breath, a breeze. On Pentecost there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind in Acts 2:2, and Paul says God gives to all life and breath and all things in Acts 17:25.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every breath I take is a gift, and the rushing wind of Pentecost was that gift poured out.
